license: Apache-2.0; original scanner and dataset authors retain attribution
selection: Five convenience-selected public Python targets with both published Semgrep and Snyk files accessible. Not a random sample or blinded holdout. Include all ten files, including empty scanner output. No selection by measured outcome.
comparison: Use identical official parser, matching predicate, non-scoring and ground-truth semantics. Compare original greedy matcher, deterministic sorted greedy, and deterministic maximum-cardinality positive matching followed by trap matching and non-scoring classification. Twenty seeded input-order perturbations of findings AND labels, plus original order. Report TP, FP, FN, TN, NS and F3, variation and max-TP gaps. Candidate maximizes positive credit, then trap assignment on remaining findings; not a global F3 optimizer or proof of semantic correctness. No new scanner or model output.
success: Report actual instability or TP gaps if present; no gain asserted from constructed cases or empty output. No network ranking or adoption claim.
